label: Moderate
meaning: At least one pollutant has reached a moderate level.
sensitiveAdvice: Consider reducing intense outdoor activity if you experience symptoms.

label: Poor
meaning: At least one pollutant has reached a poor level.
generalAdvice: If you notice sore eyes, coughing, or a sore throat, consider reducing intense outdoor activity.
sensitiveAdvice: Consider reducing physical activity, especially outdoors, particularly if you experience symptoms.

label: Very poor
meaning: At least one pollutant has reached a very poor level.
generalAdvice: If you notice sore eyes, coughing, or a sore throat, consider reducing intense outdoor activity.
sensitiveAdvice: Reduce physical activity, especially outdoors, particularly if you experience symptoms.

label: Extremely poor
meaning: At least one pollutant has reached an extremely poor level.
